Homeowners are sent to commercial services

The homepage’s Residential Window Film section sends visitors to Commercial, and the Residential page repeats commercial labels and mismatched product descriptions.

  • Change the homepage residential button to Explore Residential Services → /residential/; leave the separate commercial button unchanged.
  • On /residential/, correct Request a Request, commercial CTA labels and office-focused wording, and match each description to its named product.

Enquiry completion is not visible in GA4

GA4 records 17 form starts but returns no form-submit or phone events in the review period, leaving enquiry completion unverified.

  • Check TintPro form completion, phone clicks and GA4/GTM mapping with the tracking owner; test only after authorization.
  • Report verified enquiries separately from starts and clicks; do not describe missing events as zero real leads.
